newsitem.title: USA: Main Street Athletic plans shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Main Street Athletic plans shr offer.

text.p: Main Street Athletic Clubs Inc said it was qualified by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell its stock to the public and it planned to offer 500,000 shares at $10 per share.
Main Street founder and Chief Executive Officer Chester Billingsley said he would raise up to $5 million with an initial public offering of 500,000 shares at $10 per share.
The company said it would use proceeds to complete friendly acquisitions of upscale fitness centers and related businesses across the country.
